sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Political crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Violent standoff between parties paralyzes Dhaka ahead of scheduled elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Caretaker row
geopolitical_news.summary: Disputes over the interim government push the country toward emergency rule.

sport.headline: Cricket team on the rise
sport.summary: Bangladesh's young side shows promise in ODIs against top nations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Military-backed caretaker takes over
geopolitical_news.summary: Emergency rule is declared in January; elections are postponed.

geopolitical_news.headline: Leaders detained
geopolitical_news.summary: Both Sheikh Hasina and Khaleda Zia are arrested on graft charges.

sport.headline: World Cup Super Eight
sport.summary: Bangladesh stun India to reach the Super Eights in the Caribbean.

geopolitical_news.headline: Awami League wins landslide
geopolitical_news.summary: December elections restore democracy; Sheikh Hasina becomes prime minister.

geopolitical_news.headline: Emergency lifted
geopolitical_news.summary: Two years of military-backed rule end with the vote.

sport.headline: Cricketers tour tough venues
sport.summary: The team gains experience on difficult away tours.

geopolitical_news.headline: BDR mutiny kills officers
geopolitical_news.summary: A border guards' revolt in February leaves dozens of army officers dead.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hasina consolidates power
geopolitical_news.summary: The new government crushes the mutiny and tightens its grip.

sport.headline: First away Test series win
sport.summary: Bangladesh beat West Indies in the Caribbean for a historic series victory.

geopolitical_news.headline: War crimes tribunal set up
geopolitical_news.summary: A court is formed to try 1971 liberation war atrocities.

geopolitical_news.headline: BDR trials begin
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass trials open over the 2009 border guards mutiny.

sport.headline: Asian Games cricket gold
sport.summary: Bangladesh beat Afghanistan to win cricket gold in Guangzhou.

geopolitical_news.headline: World Cup co-hosted
geopolitical_news.summary: Bangladesh stages matches of the Cricket World Cup with India and Sri Lanka.

geopolitical_news.headline: Caretaker system scrapped
geopolitical_news.summary: A constitutional amendment ends neutral poll-time governments.

sport.headline: Hosting the World Cup
sport.summary: Dhaka and Chittagong host World Cup matches before home crowds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yunus ousted from Grameen
geopolitical_news.summary: Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus is removed from the bank he founded.

geopolitical_news.headline: Asia Cup final heartbreak
geopolitical_news.summary: Off the field, war crimes verdicts stir unrest; on it, narrow sporting loss.

sport.headline: Asia Cup final agony
sport.summary: Bangladesh lose the final to Pakistan by two runs in Mirpur.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rana Plaza collapse
geopolitical_news.summary: A factory building collapse kills over a thousand garment workers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Shahbag protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass rallies demand death for 1971 war criminals.

sport.headline: Mushfiqur's double century
sport.summary: Mushfiqur Rahim becomes the first Bangladeshi to score a Test double hundred.

geopolitical_news.headline: One-sided election
geopolitical_news.summary: The BNP boycotts January polls; Hasina is re-elected unopposed in most seats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Legitimacy questioned
geopolitical_news.summary: Western observers decline to monitor the lopsided vote.

sport.headline: T20 World Cup hosted
sport.summary: Bangladesh stages the World Twenty20 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Blogger murders
geopolitical_news.summary: Militants hack secular writers to death in a string of attacks.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cricket euphoria
geopolitical_news.summary: World Cup success briefly unites a polarized nation.

sport.headline: World Cup quarterfinal
sport.summary: Bangladesh beat England to reach a first World Cup quarterfinal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Holey Artisan attack
geopolitical_news.summary: Militants storm a Dhaka cafe in July, killing diners in a day-long siege.

geopolitical_news.headline: Security crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Forces launch sweeping operations against extremist networks.

sport.headline: Asia Cup final again
sport.summary: Bangladesh reach the T20 Asia Cup final, losing to India.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rohingya exodus
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands flee Myanmar's crackdown into Cox's Bazar.

geopolitical_news.headline: Refugee crisis grows
geopolitical_news.summary: Bangladesh hosts the world's largest refugee camp.

sport.headline: Test win over Australia
sport.summary: Bangladesh beat Australia in a Test for the first time, in Mirpur.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hasina wins disputed polls
geopolitical_news.summary: December elections return her to power amid rigging allegations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Road safety protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Student demonstrations over deadly crashes paralyze Dhaka.

sport.headline: Asia Cup final loss
sport.summary: Bangladesh lose another Asia Cup final to India, off the last ball.

geopolitical_news.headline: Post-election crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition is squeezed after the lopsided 2018 vote.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rohingya repatriation stalls
geopolitical_news.summary: Refugees refuse to return to Myanmar without guarantees.

sport.headline: Shakib stars at World Cup
sport.summary: Shakib Al Hasan scores 606 runs and takes 11 wickets in England.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID hits hard
geopolitical_news.summary: The pandemic strains hospitals and the garment economy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mujib centenary
geopolitical_news.summary: The nation marks 100 years since Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's birth.

sport.headline: Cricket resumes quietly
sport.summary: Domestic cricket restarts behind closed doors after the COVID pause.

geopolitical_news.headline: Independence golden jubilee
geopolitical_news.summary: Fifty years of independence are celebrated amid Modi-visit protests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hefazat crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Islamist group leaders are arrested after violent demonstrations.

sport.headline: T20 series wins at home
sport.summary: Bangladesh beat Australia and New Zealand in home T20 series.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic strain
geopolitical_news.summary: Falling reserves force Bangladesh to seek an IMF loan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Energy crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Power cuts and fuel shortages hit industry and homes.

sport.headline: Women win SAFF Championship
sport.summary: Bangladesh's women lift the South Asian football title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Election tensions rise
geopolitical_news.summary: The US threatens visa curbs over democratic backsliding.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yunus cases proceed
geopolitical_news.summary: Nobel laureate faces labour-law charges critics call political.

sport.headline: Tough World Cup in India
sport.summary: Bangladesh endure a disappointing ODI World Cup campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hasina ousted by uprising
geopolitical_news.summary: Weeks of student-led protests topple the premier in August; she flees.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yunus leads interim rule
geopolitical_news.summary: The Nobel laureate heads a caretaker government promising reform.

sport.headline: Test series win in Pakistan
sport.summary: Bangladesh sweep Pakistan 2-0 away, a landmark achievement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hasina faces tribunal
geopolitical_news.summary: The ousted leader is tried in absentia over the deadly crackdown.

geopolitical_news.headline: Elections promised
geopolitical_news.summary: The interim government pledges polls and constitutional reform.

sport.headline: Asia Cup campaign
sport.summary: Bangladesh contest the T20 Asia Cup in the UAE.
